key_insight: Success conditioning provably drives policy optimization toward optimal behavior in broad MDP classes, with explicit convergence guarantees.
engineering_relevance: The result gives practitioners a theoretical basis for using success-based policy updates in reinforcement learning systems where reliability and convergence speed matter.
method: Analyze success conditioning as a policy update rule in MDPs.
Prove convergence to an optimal policy for broad classes of stochastic decision problems.
Derive iteration complexity bounds for discounted and single-period MDP settings.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence analysis and rate proofs, including O(1/ε^p) iterations for discounted MDPs and O(log(1/ε)) for single-period MDPs.
watch_item: The convergence exponent p depends on problem-specific data, so practical speed may vary significantly across environments.
paper_title: On the Convergence of Success Conditioning for Policy Optimization
